title: Environmental Response / World Carries Agency

source_refs.author: Comparative cinematic environment analysis
source_refs.title: Environment as causal participant
source_refs.cultural_context: Narrative space, atmosphere, and material response

observed_structure: the environment has a stable behavioral baseline
character action produces a measurable environmental response
the response changes later choices without requiring personification
cinematic_affordances: light, weather, machinery, or crowd flow responding
later blocking adapting to environmental change
cultural_scope: general environmental agency pattern; do not claim spiritual identity for a place without project-specific provenance
transferable_structure: a stable environment responds to action and preserves the response as a causal condition for later behavior
non_transferable_surface: borrowed animist, sacred-land, or genius-loci claims without cultural and narrative grounding
